summary: A compact form page with no title or description, one section and a Cancel and Save footer.
use: Quick edit forms embedded in a larger page that already provides its own heading.
spec: `<AppForm>` is used with no title or description
`<FormSection title="Quick update">` holds `<TextField label="Name" placeholder="Enter name…" />` and `<TextField label="Email" type="email" placeholder="email@example.com" />`
